snippet.title: Jey's Empire English trailer
snippet.description:
Plays an arch-villain in this historical strategy-rpg game about the FBI in the crazy sixties.

Available on STEAM : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1051420/Jeys_Empire/

Fight the Mafia, the Black panthers, the Weatherman and the Communists.
This is a very accurate turn based strategy game, I hope you will enjoy paying it !
